The employees in the voting group will be asked two questions on their ballots:
1. Do you wish to be represented for purposes of collective bargaining by UNITED FOOD
AND COMMERCIAL WORKERS UNION, LOCAL 1564, AFL-CIO? The choices on
the ballot will be Yes or No.
2. Do you wish to be included with the Employer's other employees in the clerks unit
already represented by UNITED FOOD AND COMMERCIAL WORKERS' UNION,
LOCAL 1564, AFL-C10 at the Employer's Store #987, for the purpose of collective
bargaining? The choices on the ballot will be Yes or No.
If a majority of valid ballots are not cast for representation, they will be taken to have
indicated the employees' desire to remain unrepresented.
If a majority of the voters in the voting group who cast valid ballots vote yes to the first
question, indicating a desire to be represented by the Petitioner, and a majority of the valid
votes are cast in the affirmative on the second question, the following employees would
constitute a unit appropriate for collective bargaining:

and coffee bar clerks employed by the Employer at Store #987.

employees, janitors, office clerical employees, a scan coordinator, confidential

supervisors, and other supervisors as defined by the Act.
